seo.title: About – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Runner since 2020, triathlete since late 2022, pro from 2027. I'm from the Munich area and I love long-distance racing.

title: About me
lead: I've been running since 2020 and got into triathlon at the end of 2022. From 2027 I'm racing as a professional.
body:
It all started in 2020 with running. At the end of 2022 swimming and cycling came along, and triathlon hasn't let go of me since.

I'm from the Munich area. My home, Bavaria, means a lot to me.

## My favourite distance

What excites me most is long-distance racing. I like to race these with nothing held back. My best races so far were my two starts at Challenge Roth: in 2025 I won my age group (AK 20), and in 2026 I finished in the top 10 of all age-groupers.

## Why I coach

I'm very interested in sports science, but above all I'm interested in people. Finding the right approach for each person gives me a lot of joy. To me, there is no plan that fits everyone.
